subject.title: [Feature]: Chat session management: pin, archive, rename, and search across gateway and mobile apps

question: Should operator.write clients be allowed to call sessions.patch for only label, pinned, and archived, or should maintainers choose a different write surface before mobile session management ships?
rationale: This is a real least-privilege/security boundary choice because the same sessions.patch method also mutates admin-level session preferences and routing metadata.

options.title: Approve Param-Aware sessions.patch
options.body: Reuse the existing protocol method with a fail-closed field allowlist for label, pinned, and archived, then stack the iOS and Android UI work on that gateway change.

options.title: Add A Narrow Write RPC
options.body: Introduce a separate write-scoped organization method to avoid dynamic scoping on sessions.patch, accepting extra protocol/client surface to reduce authorization ambiguity.

options.title: Keep Admin-Only For Now
options.body: Defer mobile pin/archive/rename until maintainers are ready to expose a user-level session mutation boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve Param-Aware sessions.patch
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing protocol method with a fail-closed field allowlist for label, pinned, and archived, then stack the iOS and Android UI work on that gateway change.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is maintainer-labeled and authored by steipete, and the open adjacent Control UI session/search direction also routes through them.
